AUTOMATIC REACTOR TRIPS ON BOTH UNITS DUE TO LOSS OF A SWITCHYARD BUS

The following information was provided by the licensee via phone and email:

"At 0158 EDT on October 15, 2026, Units 3 and 4 automatically tripped from 100 percent and 98 percent power respectively following the loss of a switchyard bus. All control rods fully inserted. Auxiliary feedwater actuated as expected.

"The trips were uncomplicated. Decay heat is being removed through the steam dumps & condenser."

The NRC Resident Inspector has been notified.

AGREEMENT STATE REPORT - STUCK RADIOGRAPHY SOURCE

The following information was received from the Texas Department of State Health Services (the Department) via email:

"On October 13, 2026, the Department was notified by the licensee that a 40 curie iridium-192 source could not be retracted into its exposure device. The source was retrieved by an authorized individual. No overexposures are expected."

Event Text
UNUSUAL EVENT DECLARED DUE TO FIRE IN THE PROTECTED AREA LASTING GREATER THAN 15 MINUTES

The following information was provided by the licensee via phone:

"At 0815 CDT, an Unusual Event was declared under emergency action level HU4.1 due to a fire in a transformer yard lasting longer than 15 minutes. The fire was extinguished at 0849 CDT."

The licensee notified State and local authorities. The NRC Resident Inspector has been notified.
